name: Justworks
description_en:
Justworks offers distinct Payroll, PEO and international employment products through one small-business platform. The self-service Payroll product covers US multi-state payroll, pay documents, basic HR and employee records; PEO Basic, PEO Plus and EOR have separate per-person prices and service scopes.

The most useful comparison starts by deciding who is being paid and what service is required. Access to time tracking, insurance or international hiring does not mean those services are included in the Payroll base fee, and contractor billing uses a paid-contractor unit.
description_zh:
Justworks 通过一个小企业平台提供不同的 Payroll、PEO 及国际雇佣产品。自助 Payroll 涵盖美国多州工资、工资文档、基础 HR 及员工档案；PEO Basic、PEO Plus、EOR 各有不同人均价格和服务范围。

比较应先明确支付对象及所需服务。“可访问”工时、保险或国际招聘不代表已包含在 Payroll 基础费中，承包人员则按当月已付款人员计费。

core_features.explanation_en: Payroll lists multiple rates, custom periods, off-cycle payments, tips, digital stubs, employer tax filing and W-2/1099 filings.
core_features.explanation_zh: Payroll 列出多费率、自定义期间、额外工资、小费、电子明细、雇主税及 W-2/1099 申报。

core_features.explanation_en: The payroll feature list includes onboarding/offboarding, basic timecards, PTO, document center, directory and employee mobile access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工资功能表列出入离职、基础工时卡、PTO、文档中心、通讯录及员工移动访问。

core_features.name_zh: 独立工时及全球附加项
core_features.explanation_en: Time Tracking, US/international contractor payments, EOR and dedicated HR consulting have explicit additional pricing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工时、美国及国际承包人员、EOR 和专属 HR 咨询各有明确额外价格。

pricing.summary_en: Payroll $50/month+$8/employee; PEO Basic $79 and Plus $124/employee with no base; EOR $599. Time, paid contractors, benefits and HR consulting add separately.
pricing.summary_zh: Payroll 每月 50 美元加每员工 8；PEO Basic 人均 79、Plus 124，无基础费；EOR 599。工时、已付承包人员、福利及 HR 咨询另计。

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Choose Payroll, PEO or international employment
sections.title_zh: 选择 Payroll、PEO 或国际雇佣
sections.en: The official pricing page presents US Payroll at $8 per employee monthly plus $50 base, PEO Basic at $79 per employee and PEO Plus at $124, both without a base fee, and EOR at $599 per employee monthly. Basic adds a broader compliance and HR support scope, while Plus adds medical, dental and vision administration and related benefits. These are separate product arrangements, not three prices for identical payroll software. Determine the intended US employment, benefits and international service responsibilities with sales before comparing total cost.
sections.zh: 官方价格页列出美国 Payroll 每员工每月 8 美元加 50 美元基础费；PEO Basic 每员工 79 美元、PEO Plus 124 美元，两者无基础费；EOR 每员工每月 599 美元。Basic 增加更广合规和 HR 支持，Plus 再增加医疗、牙科和视力管理及相关福利。这是不同产品安排，不是相同工资软件的三个价格。比较总成本前，应与销售明确美国雇佣、福利及国际服务责任。

sections.title_en: Follow a pay period and a correction
sections.en: The self-service payroll page documents recurring payroll, bonuses, reimbursements, multiple pay rates, custom periods and off-cycle payments, along with reporting and employee documents. A meaningful pilot would compare regular earnings, a tip and a reimbursement with the current payroll result, then inspect a late correction and the employee’s paystub. Basic timecards are listed, but the more advanced Time Tracking product is an add-on. Define who approves hours and pay changes, and confirm funding cutoffs, supported states and reversal handling; the public feature list does not establish those operational details.
sections.zh: 自助工资页描述经常性工资、奖金、报销、多费率、自定义期间、额外工资，以及报表和员工文档。试运行可把正常收入、小费和报销与现行工资结果比较，再检查迟到更正及员工工资单。页面列有基础工时卡，但较高级 Time Tracking 属附加产品。需明确谁批准工时和工资修改，并确认供款截止、支持州及撤销；公开功能表没有确立这些运营细节。

sections.title_en: Count the paid people and selected add-ons
sections.title_zh: 按已付款人员和所选附加项计算
sections.en: Time Tracking is $8 per employee monthly, separate from Payroll’s $8 employee fee. US contractors cost $8 per paid contractor monthly; international contractors $39, with country support to check. Dedicated HR consulting is $30 per employee on Basic or Plus. Payroll health-insurance access/admin is listed at $8 per benefits-eligible employee, and CHOICE reimbursements through Thatch at $25 per enrolled employee. These administration prices do not establish the insurance premium or reimbursement amount. For ten Payroll employees and three paid US contractors, the stated base formula is $154 monthly before optional time tracking, benefits or other applicable costs; adding time tracking for all ten adds $80.
sections.zh: Time Tracking 每员工每月 8 美元，与 Payroll 的 8 美元人均费分开。美国承包人员每已付款人每月 8 美元，国际承包人员 39 美元，需核对国家支持。Basic 或 Plus 的专属 HR 咨询每员工 30 美元。Payroll 健康保险访问及管理列为每福利资格员工 8 美元，Thatch 提供的 CHOICE 报销每参保员工 25 美元。这些管理价未确立保费或报销额。十名 Payroll 员工加三名当月已付美国承包人员，按基础公式为每月 154 美元，尚未计可选考勤、福利等；十人均添加工时再加 80 美元。

sections.en: The pricing page explicitly says no additional implementation fee. That does not establish a fixed migration timeline, all custom integration costs or unlimited consulting. PEO cards advertise 24/7 support, while Payroll’s feature list gives phone/email/chat and a 24/7 resource center; do not generalize resource-center availability into identical live support for every plan. Request the migration fields, historical payroll, opening balances, supported accounting connection, support coverage and renewal/cancellation terms in writing. No free full operational plan or open-source license was established.
sections.zh: 价格页明确称不另收实施费，但未确立固定迁移时间、所有定制集成成本或无限咨询。PEO 卡宣传全天候支持，而 Payroll 功能表列电话邮件聊天及全天候资源中心，不能把资源中心可用性泛化为各套餐相同人工支持。应书面明确迁移字段、历史工资、期初余额、会计连接、支持覆盖和续订取消。未确立完整运营免费套餐或开源许可。

sections.title_en: Reconcile data before changing service arrangements
sections.title_zh: 变更服务安排前先对齐数据
sections.en: Justworks is relevant to small employers comparing standalone payroll with broader HR, benefits and global hiring services. Buyers needing only occasional document generation should weigh the base subscription and service scope. Prepare employer identifiers, employee and contractor classification, withholding data, YTD balances and benefit deductions, then reconcile a parallel period and exported totals. Exact eligibility, insurance premiums, billing minimums, signed agreements, banking, hosting, audit history, exports and recovery remain unverified. No signup, contract, employee processing, payroll, tax filing or payment was executed.
sections.zh: 小雇主在比较独立工资及更广 HR、福利和全球招聘服务时，可以评估 Justworks。仅需偶尔生成文档的买家，应衡量基础订阅及服务范围。需准备雇主编号、员工承包人员分类、代扣资料、年内累计和福利扣款，再核对并行期间及导出合计。具体资格、保费、最低账单、签署协议、银行、托管、审计、导出和恢复仍未核实，未注册、签约、处理员工、报税或付款。
